title: Japan perils
text:
Japan perils

The following table lists the perils and peril codes that 
Touchstone
 supports for Japan.

| Import peril code | Peril | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PAL | All licensed perils | |
| PFF | Fire following earthquake | |
| PES | Earthquake shake only | |
| PFL | Inland flood | |
| PPH | Precipitation flood | |
| PSH | Storm surge | |
| PTS | Tsunami | |
| PWA | All wind perils | |
| PWF | All wind plus fire | |
| PWH | Typhoon only | |
